g.text: 1 — the Oval Office's south end is a TRUE arc, not a many-sided polygon: `wall id=w_oval
exterior thickness 300 { (47000,31000) arc (36000,31000) radius 7300 cw }`. Its three south
windows sit at 25%, 50% and 75% and walk the curve by ARC LENGTH, so they land evenly with no
trigonometry in the source. 2 — the Cabinet Room's table and its fourteen chairs are one `for`
loop. 3 — the Roosevelt Room sits at the centre of the plan with no exterior wall to put a
window in, which is true of the real one. The whole drawing: 24 rooms, 1,568.98 m², 26 doors, 25
